label: Social / Behance mid
description: Default showcase quality. True supersample dpr=2 at 1080p CSS → sharp 2K stills. Photosphere face 1024; 4D fixed-eye live ambient at 1024, ≥~4s loop.

capture.note: Host must honor capture.dpr (do not force setPixelRatio(1) for HQ). Disable vignette/post on cube face snaps. Reject faces/equirect below rejectBlackMean or with std below rejectBlackStd.

photosphere.note: Cube face edge in px; equirect = 2048×1024. Minimum social / Behance mid bar.

4d.note: Fixed-eye live ambient: --orbit live --frames 32 --settle-ms ≥600 --fps 8 (32/8=4.0s loop @ 1024 face). minMadLive=1e-4 fails MAD≈0 still packs only; minMadYaw=0.02 is yaw-scale (not living steam). User-visible steam (H6) needs clear local motion + ≥~4s + audio — not docs-only. Not a static still looped as mp4; not a yaw turntable.
